sections.title: Charanam 2
lyrics: kIsha nikara parivrtha drthAvanijA kaTAkSha bhAsuradhAma nAshitAngri
sEvAlOla nikarAmaya pAsha vAraya mAmaka pApajAtam dinamanu
chAru bAhu shObhi kArmuka sAkEtha dhAma jAtarUpa nibha vasana ghOra
raNa taTa bahu dhIra kapi varahara vArirAshi ghana madha vAraNaika paTushara
rAvaNArE kuru kushalam lOkatryApi ranjanIya mrdu hAsa bhAva dukkhEShu
krpayA bhavya lIlamAkShipa mAm pAvana shrta shrI padmanAbha rUpadhara
